aligned_segments.he: תֵּדַע שֶׁזֶּה שֶׁאֵין מַרְאִין לוֹ, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בִּזְכוּתוֹ לְהָגֵן עַל אֲחֵרִים.
aligned_segments.en: When a Tzaddik says something, as long as it does not come to pass, because its time has not come, the statement is engraved in the supernal world, but does not radiate brightly, and when its time comes to be manifest, the words begin to radiate brightly.

aligned_segments.he:
לט.

מוּטָב לְקָרֵב אֶת עַצְמוֹ לְצַּדִּיק שֶׁהוּא רַחֲמָן.
aligned_segments.en: One who gives benefit to a Torah scholar must strengthen himself, that the scholar should not become disrespected in his eyes.

aligned_segments.he:
מ.

בִּזְכוּת שִׁמּוּשׁ אָדָם גָּדוֹל אָדָם נִצּוֹל מִמִּיתָה.
aligned_segments.en: One who withholds a Halacha (Torah law) from his student is as if he stole the student's ancestral inheritance.

aligned_segments.he: מא.
aligned_segments.en: Even fetuses in their mothers' wombs curse him and he is pierced full of holes as a sieve.

aligned_segments.he: הַמּוֹרֶה הֲלָכָה בִּפְנֵי רַבּוֹ, חַיָּב מִיתָה, וְרָאוּי לְהַכִּישׁוֹ נָחָשׁ, וְנִקְרָא חוֹטֵא, וּמוֹרִידִין אוֹתוֹ מִגְּדֻלָּתוֹ, וְאָזִיל לִשְׁאוֹל בְּלֹא וָלָד.
aligned_segments.en: If he teaches him (it – the student or the halacha), he merits to blessings like Joseph, and merits to teach it also in the World to Come.

aligned_segments.he: מב.
aligned_segments.en: One who does not give support to a Torah scholar from his possessions will never see a sign of blessing.

aligned_segments.he: הַמָּקוֹר שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ תִּשְׁאַב הַחָכְמָה דְּהַיְנוּ הָרַב, הִשְׁתַּדֵּל שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בָּרוּךְ וְכְּשֶׁר, וְלֹא תַחֲלִיפֶנּוּ, לֹא תָמִיר אוֹתוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: One who scoffs at the words of the sages is punished by death. Drawing close to Tzaddikim is beneficial both in this world and the next world.

aligned_segments.he:
מג.

כָּל אִישׁ יִדָּמֶה בְּמַעֲשָׂיו לְבִרְכַּת אוֹתוֹ הַשֵּׁבֶט.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik, through his word, can sentence one man to Heaven and another to Hell.

aligned_segments.he: מד.
aligned_segments.en: It is good to expend much time in order to gain one hour of closeness to the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he: כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ רָשָׁע בַּבַּיִת, אֲזַי נִסְתַּלֵּק מֵהַצַּדִּיק מַעְיַן הַתּוֹרָה.
aligned_segments.en: When a man loses some of his servants, he should worry from the day of death, or of leprosy (lit. something else).

aligned_segments.he: מַה. בִּזְכוּת קְבוּרַת הַצַּדִּיקִים בְּחוּץ לָאָרֶץ יִזְכּוּ גַּם שְׁאָר הַמֵּתִים מִגִּלְגּוּל מְחִלּוֹת.
aligned_segments.en: There is one who expounds beautifully (on the Torah), and even still he misses the true intention.

aligned_segments.he: מו.
aligned_segments.en: A Tzaddik can raise up the Torah teaching of another Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he: הַמָּמוֹן שֶׁמְּהַנֶּה אֶת הַצַּדִּיק, הֲרֵי זֶה כְּאִלּוּ עָבַד עֲבוֹדַת בֵּית-הַמִּקְדָּשׁ.
aligned_segments.en: Whatever new teachings a Tzaddik propounds in the Torah, the Holy One Blessed He quotes them in his name.

aligned_segments.he:
מז.

יֵשׁ צַדִּיקִים שֶׁאֵינָם נִקְרָאִים בְּשֵׁם רַבִּי.
aligned_segments.en: The words of wise Tzaddikim are more precious than the words of the written Torah and the Prophets.

aligned_segments.he: מח.
aligned_segments.en: One must listen and obey them, even if they show no proof. One who praises the Tzaddik, blessings will rest upon his head.

aligned_segments.he: כְּשֶׁהַצַּדִּיק אוֹמֵר אֵיזֶהוּ דִּבּוּר, כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהַדִּבּוּר לֹא נִתְקַיֵּם, שֶׁעֲדַיִן לֹא בָּא זְמַנּוֹ, הַדִּבּוּר הַזֶּה חָקוּק בָּעוֹלָם הָעֶלְיוֹן, אֲבָל אֵין מֵאִיר בִּבְהִירוּת, וּכְּשֶׁמַּגִּיעַ הַזְּמַן שֶׁיִּתְקַיֵּם, אֲזַי הַדִּבּוּר מַתְחִיל לְהָאִיר בִּבְהִירוּת.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik of a city -- all of its affairs are incumbent upon him. It is permitted for a Tzaddik to put to his service someone who reviews Halacha (i.e.  a Torah scholar), provided that he (the tzadik) teaches him (the attendant) something new.

aligned_segments.he: מט.
aligned_segments.en: One who brings a boorish (uneducated) man to be drawn close under the wings of the Tzaddik, receives reward for it.

aligned_segments.he: הַמְהַנֶּה אֶת תַּלְמִיד-חָכָם, צָרִיךְ לְחַזֵּק שֶׁלֹּא יִתְבַּזֶּה בְּעֵינָיו הַתַּלְמִיד-חָכָם.
aligned_segments.en: Through greeting a Torah authority, one will not see Hell.

aligned_segments.he: נ.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes, prayer is only effective at the time it is said, and when the prayer is stopped, the Holy One Blessed He (returns and) does His will and His desire.

aligned_segments.he: הַמּוֹנֵעַ הֲלָכָה מִתַּלְמִידוֹ, כְּאִלּוּ גּוֹזְלוֹ מִנַּחֲלַת אֲבוֹתָיו, וַאֲפִלּוּ עֻבָּרִין שֶׁבִּמְעֵי אִמָּן מְקַלְּלִין אוֹתוֹ וּמְנַקְּבִין אוֹתוֹ כִּכְבָרָה.
aligned_segments.en: One who brings a gift to a Torah scholar is as if he offered Bikurim (offering of the first fruit).

aligned_segments.he: וְאִם לִמְּדוֹ זוֹכֶה לִבְרָכוֹת כְּיוֹסֵף, וְזוֹכֶה וּמְלַמְּדָהּ לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא.
aligned_segments.en: One should not unduly task G-d.

aligned_segments.he:
נא.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְהַנֶּה תַּלְמִיד-חָכָם מִנְּכָסָיו, אֵינוֹ רוֹאֶה סִימַן בְּרָכָה לָעוֹלָם.
aligned_segments.en: One who loves the Tzaddik must guard the Tzaddik, so that there doesn't go out on him a bad reputation. All the good (kindness) that wicked people do is harmful (bad) to the tzaddikim.

aligned_segments.he:
נב.

הַמְלַגְלֵג עַל דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים, הוּא נֶעֱנָשׁ מִיתָה.
aligned_segments.en: Do not pray and burden your Creator, so long as you can reach your objective through your own action.

aligned_segments.he:
נג.

קִרְבַת הַצַּדִּיקִים טוֹב בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וּבָעוֹלָם הַבָּא.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik, as long as he is in this world, the Heaven ('Gan Eden') that is reserved for him is used by other tzaddikim in Heaven.

aligned_segments.he:
נד.

הַצַּדִּיק בְּדִבּוּרוֹ יָכוֹל לִפְסֹק לָזֶה גַּן-עֵדֶן וְלָזֶה גֵיהִנֹּם.
aligned_segments.en: There are students who are primarily dependent on the merit of the Tzaddik. When the Tzaddik passes away, then they too pass away, or they are punished.

aligned_segments.he:
נה.

טוֹב לְבַלּוֹת זְמַן רַב, בִּשְׁבִיל שָׁעָה אַחַת, שֶׁיִּתְקָרֵב לַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: Those who are close to a certain Tzaddik in his lifetime, they will be close to him after his death ( there is an alternate reading – their death).

aligned_segments.he:
נו.

כְּשֶׁנִּתְמַעֵט לָאָדָם מְשַׁמְּשָׁיו, יִדְאַג מִיּוֹם הַמִּיתָה אוֹ מִדָּבָר אַחֵר.
aligned_segments.en: One who had been close to one Tzaddik, and afterwards draws close to a different Tzaddik, the Torah teachings he heard from the first, encumber him.

aligned_segments.he:
נז.

יֵשׁ נָאֶה דּוֹרֵשׁ, וְאַף-עַל-פִּי-כֵן אֵינוֹ מְכַוֵּן אֶל הָאֱמֶת.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes a Tzaddik passes away, in order to be the pivotal decider of some ruling Above.

aligned_segments.he:
נח.

צַדִּיק יָכוֹל לְהַגְבִּיהַּ תּוֹרָה שֶׁל צַדִּיק אַחֵר.
aligned_segments.en: Who is destined to inherit the World to Come? One who is granted honor due to his wisdom.

aligned_segments.he:
נט.

מַה שֶּׁהַצַּדִּיק מְחַדֵּשׁ בַּתּוֹרָה, הַקָּדוֹשׁ- בָּרוּךְ-הוּא אוֹמְרָהּ בִּשְׁמוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: Through giving charity, one gains the quality of distancing himself from wrongdoing. It is not necessary to punish your student and banish him from your presence, when he does not want to go in the straight path.

aligned_segments.he: ס.
aligned_segments.en: Rather, draw him close to you, for this is beneficial to the other students, and eventually he will reform (lit. give heart).

aligned_segments.he: דִּבְרֵי צַדִּיקִים חֲכָמִים חֲבִיבִים מִדִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה וּמִדִּבְרֵי נְבִיאִים, וְצָרִיךְ לִשְׁמֹעַ וּלְצַיֵּת אוֹתָם אַף-עַל-פִּי שֶׁאֵין מַרְאִין לְךָ שׁוּם מוֹפֵת.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes a man dies before his time due to the grievance of a Tzaddik against him.

aligned_segments.he:
סא.

מִי שֶׁמְשַׁבֵּחַ אֶת הַצַּדִּיק, יָנוּחוּ בְּרָכוֹת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: It is possible for a man to be a great Tzaddik, even though he did not learn a lot.

aligned_segments.he:
סב.

הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁבָּעִיר - כָּל דִּבְרֵיהֶם עָלָיו מֻטָּל.
aligned_segments.en: One who does not believe in the words of the tzaddikim is fit to be punished, all the more so one who ridicules them.

aligned_segments.he: סג.
aligned_segments.en: When one comes to draw close to a Tzaddik, he (the tzaddik) is allowed to distance him when he asks unnecessary questions.

aligned_segments.he: מֻתָּר לְצַדִּיק לְשַׁמֵּשׁ עִם מִי שֶׁהוּא שׁוֹנֵה הֲלָכוֹת, כְּשֶׁהוּא מְלַמְּדוֹ אֵיזֶהוּ דָּבָר חָדָשׁ.
aligned_segments.en: When a Tzaddik delivers a Torah teaching to the people, he is permitted to endear his teaching in their eyes before he says it.

aligned_segments.he: סד.
aligned_segments.en: Even a person's first (intended) soulmate can be changed through prayer.

aligned_segments.he: מִי שֶׁמֵּבִיא אֶת עַם-הָאָרֶץ לִקְרֹב תַּחַת כַּנְפֵי הַצַּדִּיק מְקַבֵּל עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה שָׂכָר.
aligned_segments.en: In this world anyone who wants to bring himself close – can draw close.

aligned_segments.he:
סה.

עַל-יְדֵי הַקְבָּלַת פְּנֵי הָרַב לֹא יִרְאֶה שַׁחַת.
aligned_segments.en: But in the World to Come, only those who were already close will be drawn close(r).

aligned_segments.he: סו.
aligned_segments.en: A Tzaddik who drew a person close, but the person did not want to draw himself close, it is permitted for him (the tzaddik) to push him away (with his hands).

aligned_segments.he: לִפְעָמִים הַתְּפִלָּה אֵינָהּ מוֹעֶלֶת אֶלָּא בִּשְׁעָתָהּ, וּכְּשֶׁפּוֹסְקִין מִלְהִתְפַּלֵּל, עוֹשֶׂה הַקָּדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא רְצוֹנוֹ וְחֶפְצוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik can punish a person with death, even through being disheartened – even mistakenly.

aligned_segments.he:
סז.

הַמֵּבִיא דּוֹרוֹן לְתַלְמִיד-חָכָם, כְּאִלּוּ מַקְרִיב בִּכּוּרִים.
aligned_segments.en: Things that you hear (directly) from the mouth of a Tzaddik are more effective than what you learn from books.

aligned_segments.he:
סח.

אֵין לְהַטְרִיחַ אֶת הַמָּקוֹם.
aligned_segments.en: A person understands better when he sees the face of the speaker.

aligned_segments.he: סט.
aligned_segments.en: Through the casual (lit. light) speech of the Tzaddik, a great light is opened up.

aligned_segments.he: מִי שֶׁאוֹהֵב אֶת הַצַּדִּיק, צָרִיךְ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת הַצַּדִּיק, שֶׁלֹּא יֵצֵא עָלָיו שֵׁם רָע.
aligned_segments.en: Then it is easy for people to attain high wisdoms.

aligned_segments.he:
ע.

כָּל טוֹבָתָן שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים רָעָה הִיא אֵצֶל הַצַּדִּיקִים.
aligned_segments.en: One who does not behave properly, it is permitted to enslave him. Sometimes a Tzaddik raises up a man, and then humbles him, and this is for the man's benefit.

aligned_segments.he: עא. אַל תִּתְפַּלֵּל וְאַל תַּטְרִיחַ אֶת קוֹנְךָ, כָּל זְמַן שֶׁאַתָּה יָכוֹל לַעֲשׂוֹת בִּפְעֻלָּה.
aligned_segments.en: There is a Tzaddik who is called "good", and there is a Tzaddik who is not called "good", and there is an evildoer who is evil, and an evildoer who is not evil.

aligned_segments.he: עב.
aligned_segments.en: It is a disgrace, and lowliness of the generation, when the people are subject to a leader who has no one to do his work for him.

aligned_segments.he: הַצַּדִּיק - כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהוּא בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה, הַגַּן- עֵדֶן שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ מִשְׁתַּמְּשִׁין בּוֹ הַצַּדִּיקִים הָאֲחֵרִים שֶׁבְּגַן-עֵדֶן.
aligned_segments.en: To teach others (Torah) is greater than doing (actual fulfillment of the Torah).

aligned_segments.he: עג.
aligned_segments.en: One should be careful not to show hasidus (special piety in keeping the Torah and devotion to G-d)  before great people (leaders).

aligned_segments.he: יֵשׁ תַּלְמִידִים שֶׁעִקָּרָם תְּלוּיִים בִּזְכוּת הַצַּדִּיק, וּכְּשֶׁנִּסְתַּלֵק הַצַּדִּיק אֲזַי נִסְתַּלְּקִים גַּם הֵם אוֹ נֶעֱנָשִׁים.
aligned_segments.en: The essence of a man is recognizable according to his drawing close, by seeing to whom he his close.

aligned_segments.he:
עד.

הַמְקֹרָבִים שֶׁיֵּשׁ לַצַּדִּיק בְּחַיָּיו, הֵם יִהְיוּ מְקֹרָבִים בְּמוֹתָם ]בְּמוֹתוֹ[.
aligned_segments.en: A Tzaddik  should not endanger himself by praying alone, to the extent that he is endangered, rather he should have another Tzaddik join him.

aligned_segments.he: עה.
aligned_segments.en: A Tzaddik has the power to pray for a man, that he should be saved from sins.

aligned_segments.he: מִי שֶׁהָיָה מְקֹרָב לְצַּדִּיק אֶחָד, וְאַחַר-כָּךְ מְקָרֵב אֶת עַצְמוֹ לְצַדִּיק אַחֵר, הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁשָּׁמַע מֵהַצַּדִּיק הָרִאשׁוֹן מַטְרִידִין אוֹתוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik is the image of G-d of the generation. The Tzaddik bears those who bear him at the time of their pain.

aligned_segments.he:
עו.

לִפְעָמִים הַצַּדִּיק נִפְטַר, כְּדֵי שֶׁיַּכְרִיעַ אֵיזֶה דִּין לְמַעְלָה.
aligned_segments.en: It is possible for someone to be a Tzaddik, even if he does not possess the trait of trust (in G-d) in completeness.

aligned_segments.he:
עז.

אִיזֶהוּ בֶּן עוֹלָם הַבָּא, זֶה שֶׁחוֹלְקִין לוֹ כָּבוֹד מֵחֲמַת חָכְמָתוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik can take delight (from the physical world), and need not fear from the evil inclination, for his Torah protects him.

aligned_segments.he:
עח.

עַל-יְדֵי צְדָקָה נַעֲשֶׂה סוּר מֵרָע.
aligned_segments.en: Someone who does not stand up before his rabbi is called "wicked", and does not live a long life, and his Torah learning is forgotten.

aligned_segments.he: עט.
aligned_segments.en: One should not burden the blessed G-d, when one can be helped through other means.

aligned_segments.he: אִינְךָ זָקוּק לְיַסֵּר תַּלְמִידְךָ וּלְסַלְקוֹ מִלְּפָנֶיךָ, כְּשֶׁאֵינוֹ רוֹצֶה לֵילֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ הַיָּשָׁר, אֶלָּא תְּקָרְבֵהוּ, כִּי זֶה טוֹבַת שְׁאָר הַתַּלְמִידִים, וְסוֹפוֹ לָתֵת לֵב.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes, through one bit of satisfaction one brings to the Tzaddik, through this one merits to the World to Come. One who has complete faith in the blessed G-d can give satisfaction to the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
צ.

לִפְעָמִים אָדָם מֵת קֹדֶם זְמַנּוֹ עַל-יְדֵי תַּרְעֹמֶת צַדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: One who does not have a trace of thoughts of idolatry, he constantly longs to save the tzaddikim.

aligned_segments.he:
צא.

יָכוֹל לִהְיוֹת שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אָדָם צַדִּיק גָּדוֹל, אַף- עַל-פִּי שֶּׁלֹּא לָמַד הַרְבֵּה.
aligned_segments.en: One who wants to do a favor for the Tzaddik, the Holy One Blessed He gives him strength for it.. A Torah scholar who shows impudence to his rabbis causes his years to be shortened.

aligned_segments.he:
צב.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מַאֲמִין בְּדִבְרֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים, רָאוּי לְעֹנֶשׁ, כָּל-שֶׁכֵּן מְלַגְלֵג.
aligned_segments.en: One who conducts himself with Rabbinic authority when there is someone greater than him, his years are shortened.

aligned_segments.he: צג. כְּשֶׁאֶחָד בָּא לְקָרֵב אֶת עַצְמוֹ לַצַּדִּיק, מֻתַּר לוֹ לְהַרְחִיקוֹ, כְּשֶׁשּׁוֹאֵל קֻשְׁיוֹת שֶׁאֵינוֹ צָרִיךְ.
aligned_segments.en: When a Tzaddik needs to pray to be given something, and he fears from forces challenging his righteousness, he should ask for the opposite of what he wants.

aligned_segments.he: צד. כְּשֶׁהַצַּדִּיק אוֹמֵר תּוֹרָה לָעָם, מֻתָּר לוֹ לְחַבֵּב תּוֹרָתוֹ בְּעֵינֵיהֶם קֹדֶם שֶׁיֹּאמַר.
aligned_segments.en: When a wicked man does some evil, and comes to the Tzaddik and asks him if what he (the wicked man) did was acceptable, it is permissible (for the Tzaddik) to tell him, "You did well", in order to save himself (lit.

aligned_segments.he:
צה.

אֲפִלּוּ זִוּוּג רִאשׁוֹן מִתְהַפֵּךְ בִּתְפִלָּה.
aligned_segments.en: his soul). One who separates people from coming under the wings of the Divine Presence causes his sons to fall into slavery.

aligned_segments.he: צו.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes it is necessary to pray for mercy on a sick person - that he should die.

aligned_segments.he: בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה כָּל הָרוֹצֶה לְקָרֵב אֶת עַצְמוֹ מְקָרֵב, אֲבָל בָּעוֹלָם הַבָּא אֵין מְקָרְבִין אֶלָּא הַמְקֹרָבִין מִכְּבָר.
aligned_segments.en: First the Holy One Blessed He reveals a secret of the Torah to a Tzaddik, and afterwards, the Holy One Blessed He says this Torah in the name of that Tzaddik .

aligned_segments.he: צז.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes the Tzaddik fasts and prays, and it does not help.

aligned_segments.he: צַדִּיק שֶׁקֵּרֵב אֶת הָאָדָם, וְהָאָדָם הַזֶּה לֹא רָצָה לְקָרֵב אֶת עַצְמוֹ, מֻתָּר לוֹ לִדְחוֹת בְּיָדַיִם.
aligned_segments.en: It is permitted for the Tzaddik to break through the (religious) safeguards of others to forge his own way.

aligned_segments.he: צח.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes it is decreed from Above that a number of people should die, and there is one among them that the Tzaddik loves.

aligned_segments.he: הַצַּדִּיק יָכוֹל לַעֲנשׁ אֶת הָאָדָם בְּמִיתָה, אֲפִלּוּ עַל-יְדֵי חֲלִישׁוּת דַּעְתּוֹ, אֲפִלּוּ בְּטָעוּת.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik has the power to pray for him, and save him, and put another in his place.

aligned_segments.he: צט.
aligned_segments.en: A Tzaddik has the power to take from one and give to another.

aligned_segments.he: דְּבָרִים שֶׁאַתָּה שׁוֹמֵעַ מִפִּי הַצַּדִּיק, הֵם מוֹעִילִים יוֹתֵר, מִמַּה שֶׁאַתָּה לוֹמֵד בִּסְפָרִים.
aligned_segments.en: The blessing of a Tzaddik  is a Pidyon (redemption, ransom). Each Tzaddik has a matter of devotion that another Tzaddik,  even one greater than he, cannot attain (conception of) his service.

aligned_segments.he:
צ.

אָדָם מֵבִין יוֹתֵר, כְּשֶׁרוֹאֶה פְּנֵי הַמְדַבֵּר.
aligned_segments.en: That which tzaddikim travel from place to place for (to raise) money, it is because the words of Torah are poor in one place and rich in another.

aligned_segments.he: צא.
aligned_segments.en: Length of years comes to Torah scholars when they honor each other.

aligned_segments.he: עַל-יְדֵי דִּבּוּר קַל שֶׁל הַצַּדִּיק נִפְתָּח אוֹר גָּדוֹל, אָז בְּנָקֵל לִבְנֵי-אָדָם לְהַשִּׂיג חָכְמוֹת רָמוֹת.
aligned_segments.en: There is no comparing the prayer of a Tzaddik  who is the son of a Tzaddik, to the prayer of a Tzaddik who is the son of a wicked man.

aligned_segments.he:
צב.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ נוֹהֵג כְּשֶׁוּרָה, מֻתָּר לְהִשְׁתַּעְבֵּד בּוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: One who puts the Tzaddik  to the test is as if he tests the Holy One Blessed He.

aligned_segments.he: צג. לִפְעָמִים הַצַּדִּיק מְנַשֵּׂא אֶת הָאָדָם וְאַחַר כָּךְ מַשְׁפִּילוֹ וְזֶה לְטוֹבַת הָאִישׁ.
aligned_segments.en: All the levies that the nations demand from the Jewish People are only due to the violation that they violated the honor of the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he: צד.
aligned_segments.en: When those who hate G-d slander and stand against the Tzaddik, it is a great honor for the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he: יֵשׁ צַדִּיק נִקְרָא טוֹב, וְיֵשׁ צַדִּיק שֶׁאֵינוֹ נִקְרָא טוֹב, וְיֵשׁ רָשָׁע רָע, וְיֵשׁ רָשָׁע שֶׁאֵינוֹ רָע.
aligned_segments.en: Through faith in tzaddikim, the Din (judgement) is sweetened.

aligned_segments.he: צה.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik teaches G-d through his Torah (exegesis), how to deal with us.

aligned_segments.he: גְּנַאי הוּא וְשִׁפְלוּת לְדוֹר, שֶׁכְּפוּפִין לָזֶה שֶׁאֵין לוֹ מִי שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה מְלַאכְתּוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: The prayer a person prays with attachment to the tzaddikim, it is answered.

aligned_segments.he:
צו.

לְלַמֵּד לַאֲחֵרִים עָדִיף מִמַּעֲשֶׂה.
aligned_segments.en: The Holy One Blessed He forgives the sins of Israel for the sake of the tzaddikim.

aligned_segments.he:
צז.

יֵשׁ לְהִזָּהֵר מִלְּהַרְאוֹת חֲסִידוּת לִפְנֵי גְּדוֹלִים.
aligned_segments.en: The mockery, does not allow one to go to the tzaddikim. Through charity, one merits to come close to tzaddikim.

aligned_segments.he:
צח.

מַהוּת הָאָדָם נִכָּר עַל-יְדֵי הִתְקָרְבוּתוֹ, כְּשֶׁרוֹאִין לְמִי הוּא מְקֹרָב.
aligned_segments.en: There is no Tzaddik who does not have a conflict on him, and investigators. There is a (type of) evildoer who is ashamed to blaspheme the Tzaddik  himself, and so he slanders those that are under the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he: צט.
aligned_segments.en: Through seeing the face of the Tzaddik,  the intellect is sharpened.

aligned_segments.he: הַצַּדִּיק - אַל יְסַכֵּן עַצְמוֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּל בְּעַצְמוֹ, עַד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה הוּא מְסֻכָּן, אֶלָּא יִשְׁתַּתֵּף עִמּוֹ צַדִּיק אַחֵר.
aligned_segments.en: One who protects the Tzaddik,  that no suffering should come to him, will merit to honor, and will benefit from the righteousness of the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
ק.

הַצַּדִּיק יֵשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ לְהִתְפַּלֵּל עַל אָדָם, שֶׁיִּנָּצֵל מֵחֲטָאִים.
aligned_segments.en: Through hearing Torah directly from the (mouth of the) Tzaddik, one receives vitality. An evildoer who has committed many sins, his rectification is – that his actions should be (geared) to give vitality to the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
קא.

הַצַּדִּיק הוּא הַצֶּלֶם-אֱלֹקִים שֶׁל הַדּוֹר.
aligned_segments.en: When an evildoer submits himself under the Tzaddik,  it is certain that some hardship had been decreed upon the Tzaddik, and now the hardship will no longer come upon him.

aligned_segments.he:
קב.

הַצַּדִּיק הוּא סוֹבֵל לְסוֹבְלָיו בְּעֵת צָרָתָם.
aligned_segments.en: When you have fear of the Tzaddik, you will merit to distance yourself from wrongdoing.

aligned_segments.he:
קג.

יָכוֹל אָדָם שֶׁיִּהְיֶה צַדִּיק, אַף-עַל-פִּי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ בִּטָּחוֹן בִּשְׁלֵמוּת.
aligned_segments.en: When a Tzaddik is set with pain, and an evildoer asks for mercy on his behalf, through this he will merit in the future to stand at the gates of a Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he: קד. הַצַּדִּיק יָכוֹל לְהִתְעַנֵּג, וְאֵינוֹ יָרֵא מֵהַיֵּצֶר הָרָע, כִּי תּוֹרָתוֹ מֵגֵנָּה עָלָיו.
aligned_segments.en: That which the Holy One Blessed He does not heed the prayer of the Tzaddik, (it is) in order to thus reject the evildoers, that they should remain in their wickedness.

aligned_segments.he: קה.
aligned_segments.en: Through conflict on the Tzaddik, the Torah is forgotten.

aligned_segments.he: מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ עוֹמֵד בִּפְנֵי רַבּוֹ, נִקְרָא רָשָׁע וְאֵינוֹ מַאֲרִיךְ יָמִים וְתַלְמוּדוֹ מִשְׁתַּכֵּחַ.
aligned_segments.en: The praise that is extolled of the tzaddikim is as if it is praise to the Holy One Blessed He.

aligned_segments.he:
קו.

אֵין לְהַטְרִיחַ אֶת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ כְּשֶׁיְּכוֹלִין לְהוֹעִיל עַל-יְדֵי דָּבָר אַחֵר.
aligned_segments.en: A city that obeys the Tzaddik, no war is heard in it, and there are no upheavals or evil tidings. The opposition to the tzaddikim comes from the opposition between the tzaddikim themselves.

aligned_segments.he: קז. לִפְעָמִים עַל-יְדֵי נַחַת-רוּחַ אֶחָד וּמְעַט שֶׁעוֹשִׂין לַצַּדִּיק, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה זוֹכִין לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא.
aligned_segments.en: For this reason the Holy One Blessed He gives livelihood to a Tzaddik through the general populace, in order that he will have some connection with them, [and] so that when the Holy One Blessed He remembers the Tzaddik, He will remember them as well.

aligned_segments.he: קח.
aligned_segments.en: The coming of the Messiah depends on drawing close to the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he: מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ אֱמוּנָה שְׁלֵמָה בַּשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, יָכוֹל לַעֲשׂוֹת נַחַת-רוּחַ לַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: The primary fulfillment of the soul comes through drawing close to the tzaddikim.

aligned_segments.he: קט. מִי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ שׁוּם הִרְהוּרֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה, הוּא מִשְׁתּוֹקֵק תָּמִיד לְהַצִּיל אֶת הַצַּדִּיקִים.
aligned_segments.en: Someone who draws close to the Tzaddik, but his drawing close is not with sincerity (innocence), through this he is turned around afterwards to be an opposer.

aligned_segments.he:
קי.

מִי שֶׁרוֹצֶה לַעֲשׂוֹת טוֹבָה לַצַּדִּיק, הַקָּדוֹשׁ- בָּרוּךְ-הוּא נוֹתֵן לוֹ כֹּחַ לָזֶה.
aligned_segments.en: A liar – when he comes to see the Tzaddik - his heart contemplates how he will speak afterwards. The words that people speak against the Tzaddik, in the end their words are turned around against them, and they fall bedridden.

aligned_segments.he:
קיא.

תַּלְמִיד-חָכָם הַמְבַעֵט בְּרַבּוֹתָיו, נִתְקַצְּרוּ שְׁנוֹתָיו.
aligned_segments.en: One who submits himself before the Tzaddik, with this he arouses the love of the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
קיב.

הַמַּנְהִיג עַצְמוֹ בָּרַבָּנוּת כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ גָּדוֹל מִמֶּנּוּ, נִתְקַצְּרִים שְׁנוֹתָיו.
aligned_segments.en: Through the stories of the tzaddikim, through this one merits to draw close to them. According to the Divine Inspiration the Holy One Blessed He grants to a Tzaddik, so the wealthy people support him.

aligned_segments.he: קיג.
aligned_segments.en: According to the support they give him, so he can bring the evildoers back in repentance.

aligned_segments.he: כְּשֶׁהַצַּדִּיק צָרִיךְ לְהִתְפַּלֵּל שֶׁיִּתְנוּ לוֹ אֵיזֶה דָּבָר וְיָרֵא מֵהַמְקַטְרְגִים עַל צִדְקָתוֹ, יְבַקֵּשׁ הֵפֶךְ רְצוֹנוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: The suffering that comes upon the tzaddikim, is so that in the World to Come, the wicked will not question (in their minds) the good that the Holy One Blessed He will be giving the tzaddikim.

aligned_segments.he: קיד. כְּשֶׁרָשָׁע עוֹשֶׂה אֵיזֶה רָעָה וּבָא לְהַצַּדִּיק וְשׁוֹאֵל מִמֶּנּוּ אִם יָפֶה עָשָׂה, מֻתָּר לוֹמַר לוֹ: יָפֶה עָשִׂיתָ, כְּדֵי לְהַצִּיל אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: When the G-d fearing are connected to the Tzaddik, through this they cause a union between the Holy One, Blessed be He, and the Divine Presence, face to face, and there is no regression from this afterwards.

aligned_segments.he: קטו.
aligned_segments.en: Through the praises that one extolls the tzaddikim, the wicked are pushed down to a great fall.

aligned_segments.he: מִי שֶׁמַּפְרִישׁ בְּנֵי-אָדָם מִלָּבוֹא תַּחַת כַּנְפֵי הַשְּׁכִינָה, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה נוֹפְלִים בָּנָיו לְעַבְדוּת.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik passes away due to the sins of witchcraft and promiscuity.

aligned_segments.he:
קטז.

לִפְעָמִים צָרִיךְ לְבַקֵּשׁ רַחֲמִים עַל הַחוֹלֶה שֶׁיָּמוּת.
aligned_segments.en: The promiscuous are for the most part opposers of the tzaddikim. When the Tzaddik passes away, the world (the people) remain as though impure, and the righteousness of the world is disgusting in the eyes of the Holy One Blessed He.

aligned_segments.he: קיז.
aligned_segments.en: Through the haughtiness people hold above the Tzaddik, there is aroused, G-d forbid, Divine wrath.

aligned_segments.he: בַּתחִלָּה הַקָּדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא מְגַלֶּה הַסּוֹד בַּתּוֹרָה לַצַּדִּיק, וְאַחַר-כָּךְ אוֹמֵר הַקָּדוֹשׁ- בָּרוּךְ-הוּא הַתּוֹרָה בִּשְׁבִיל ]בְּשֵׁם[ הַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: Also fires (lit. burning) are aroused. The wandering about of the tzaddikim is sometimes in order to reveal some hidden Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
קיח.

לִפְעָמִים הַצַּדִּיק מִתְעַנֶּה וּמִתְפַּלֵּל וְאֵינוֹ מוֹעִיל.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes suffering comes upon the Tzaddik, in order to decrease the hardships of Israel.

aligned_segments.he:
קיט.

הַצַּדִּיק מֻתָּר לוֹ לִפְרֹץ גְּדָרִים שֶׁל אֲחֵרִים בִּשְׁבִיל דַּרְכּוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: The gluttonous eating  of the masses causes the loss of the Tzaddik. The sufferings that come upon the tzaddikim are an atonement for all of the Jewish People.

aligned_segments.he: קכ.
aligned_segments.en: One who does not want to accept upon himself the yoke of the Tzaddik, the Holy One Blessed He is angry at him and kicks him.

aligned_segments.he: לִפְעָמִים גּוֹזְרִים מִלְמַעְלָה עַל מִסְפַּר בְּנֵי- אָדָם שֶׁיָּמוּתוּ, וְיֵשׁ אֶחָד בֵּינֵיהֶם שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק אוֹהֵב אוֹתוֹ, יֵשׁ כֹּחַ בַּצַּדִּיק לְהִתְפַּלֵּל עָלָיו וּלְהַצִּיל אוֹתוֹ וְלִתֵּן אַחֵר תַּחְתָּיו.
aligned_segments.en: One who brings a gift to the Tzaddik, the Holy One Blessed He gives him satisfaction. Through the gifts that people bring to tzaddikim, the enemies are subdued, and there is annulment of the evil spirit that sets upon a person.

aligned_segments.he:
קכא.

יֵשׁ כֹּחַ בַּצַּדִּיק לִקַּח מִזֶּה וְלִתֵּן לָזֶה.
aligned_segments.en: Through prostrating oneself on the tombs of tzaddikim, the Holy One Blessed He does favors for him, even if he is not worthy of such.

aligned_segments.he:
קכב.

בִּרְכַּת הַצַּדִּיק הוּא פִּדְיוֹן.
aligned_segments.en: Someone who recounts stories of the tzaddikim, the Holy One Blessed He does him kindness.

aligned_segments.he: קכג.
aligned_segments.en: That which the Tzaddik  rules over the world (-people) is due to the fear of G-d within him.

aligned_segments.he: כָּל צַדִּיק יֵשׁ לוֹ דְּבַר עֲבוֹדָה, שֶׁצַּדִּיק אַחֵר, אֲפִלּוּ גָּדוֹל מִמֶּנּוּ, אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְהַשִּׂיג עֲבוֹדָתוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: When a man is being blessed by the Tzaddik, he should stand on his feet.

aligned_segments.he: קכד.
aligned_segments.en: A king is permitted to collect his expenses from the people.

aligned_segments.he: מַה שֶּׁהַצַּדִּיקִים נוֹסְעִים מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם בִּשְׁבִיל מָמוֹן, כִּי דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה עֲנִיִּים בִּמְקוֹמָם וַעֲשִׁירִים בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר.
aligned_segments.en: Through the honor people extend to the children of the tzaddikim, the desire is aroused in the blessed G-d for the arrival of the Messiah.

aligned_segments.he:
קכה.

אֲרִיכַת יָמִים שֶׁל תַּלְמִיד-חָכָם בָּא, כְּשֶׁמְּכַבְּדִין זֶה אֶת זֶה.
aligned_segments.en: Through the (act of) going – that people go to the Tzaddik, they subdue the wicked. One who transgresses the command of the Tzaddik, he falls from his importance.

aligned_segments.he:
קכו.

אִינָהּ דּוֹמָה תְּפִלַּת צַדִּיק בֶּן צַדִּיק לִתְפִלַּת צַדִּיק בֶּן רָשָׁע.
aligned_segments.en: One who gives the Tzaddik enjoyment (benefit) from his property, is as if he benefited all of Israel, and he is saved from death.

aligned_segments.he:
קכז.

מִי שֶׁמְּנַסֶּה אֶת הַצַּדִּיק, כְּאִלּוּ מְנַסֶּה אֶת הַקָּדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא.
aligned_segments.en: One who disobeys (by refusal to perform) the words of the Tzaddik, is as if he engaged in the asking of diviners.

aligned_segments.he: קכח.
aligned_segments.en: Through wisdom, G-d is with one, and also the fear of him is cast upon the people.

aligned_segments.he: כָּל הַגְּבִיּוֹת שֶׁאֻמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם גּוֹבִין מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל, אֵין זֶה אֶלָּא בִּשְׁבִיל הַפְּגָם שֶׁפָּגְמוּ בִּכְבוֹד הַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: One who supports the Tzaddik with all types of support, he is close and near to him in the World to Come.

aligned_segments.he: קכט.
aligned_segments.en: One who starts up with the Tzaddik, in the end he is caught in a bad trap.

aligned_segments.he: כְּשֶׁשּׂוֹנְאֵי הַשֵּׁם דּוֹבְרִים וְחוֹלְקִים עַל הַצַּדִּיק, הוּא כָּבוֹד גָּדוֹל לַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: One who recounts the stories of tzaddikim, his righteousness is recalled.

aligned_segments.he:
קל.

עַל-יְדֵי אֱמוּנַת צַדִּיקִים נִמְתָּק הַדִּין.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik can give something that has not yet come into the world.

aligned_segments.he: קלא.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik – everywhere his feet tread, he acquires.

aligned_segments.he: הַצַּדִּיק הוּא מְלַמֵּד אֶת הַקָּדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא בְּתוֹרָתוֹ, אֵיךְ יִתְנַהֵג עִמָּנוּ.
aligned_segments.en: Someone who gives advice to tzaddikim at a time when they are facing opposition, the work of his hands endures, and will not be annulled.

aligned_segments.he:
קלב.

הַתְּפִלָּה שֶּׁאָדָם מִתְפַּלֵּל בְּהִתְקַשְּׁרוּת הַצַּדִּיקִים, הוּא נַעֲנֶה.
aligned_segments.en: At the time when one looks upon the Tzaddik, he should look with dread, so that he will not be punished by Heaven.

aligned_segments.he:
קלג.

הַקָּדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא מוֹחֵל עֲווֹנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁבִיל הַצַּדִּיקִים.
aligned_segments.en: Through fear of Heaven, a persons gains a longing to draw himself close to the Tzaddik. Through sitting at the table of the Tzaddik, war is annulled.

aligned_segments.he:
קלד.

הַלֵּיצָנוּת אֵינוֹ מַנִּיחַ אֶת הָאָדָם לֵילֵךְ לְצַּדִּיקִים.
aligned_segments.en: One who is a forger, in the end he will join the opposers who stand against the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
קלה.

עַל-יְדֵי צְדָקָה זוֹכֶה לְהִתְקָרְבוּת לַצַּדִּיקִים.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes the plague of leprosy breaks out upon the Tzaddik, because he had recently brought someone back in repentance.

aligned_segments.he:
קלו.

אֵין לְךָ צַדִּיק שֶׁאֵין עָלָיו מַחֲלֹקֶת וּמְחַקְּרִים.
aligned_segments.en: Someone who says of a Tzaddik that he is wicked, and of a wicked one that he is a Tzaddik, through this he falls into a state of weakness, also the sun and moon are eclipsed.

aligned_segments.he: קלז.
aligned_segments.en: Connection to the Tzaddik is a great healing.

aligned_segments.he: יֵשׁ רָשָׁע שֶׁהוּא בּוֹשׁ לִכְפֹּר בַּצַּדִּיק עַצְמוֹ וּמְדַבֵּר רָעוֹת עַל אֵלּוּ שֶׁהֵם תַּחַת הַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: It is hard for a man to receive a salvation, when there is a Tzaddik  in the city, and he (the man) does not ask the Tzaddik  to pray for him.

aligned_segments.he:
קלח.

עַל-יְדֵי רְאִיַּת פְּנֵי הַצַּדִּיק נִתְחַדֵּד הַשֵּׂכֶל.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes a person comes very close to the Tzaddik, and yet does not feel within himself any fear of Heaven.

aligned_segments.he: קלט.
aligned_segments.en: He should know that if he had not come close, he would not be worthy of living at all.

aligned_segments.he: מִי שֶׁשּׁוֹמֵר אֶת הַצַּדִּיק, שֶׁלֹּא יִפֹּל בּוֹ שׁוּם צַעַר, יִזְכֶּה לְכָבוֹד וְיֶהֱנֶה מִצִּדְקַת הַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes a Tzaddik is ashamed to pray to the Holy One Blessed He about his personal suffering.

aligned_segments.he:
קמ.

עַל-יְדֵי שְׁמִיעַת תּוֹרָה מִפִּי הַצַּדִּיק מְקַבְּלִין חִיּוּת.
aligned_segments.en: What does the Holy One Blessed He do? He brings similar suffering upon an evildoer, so that when the evildoer comes and asks from him (the tzaddik) to pray for him, and through this, the Tzaddik is also saved from his suffering.

aligned_segments.he: קמא.
aligned_segments.en: One who disputes the Tzaddik in front of him, it is certain that he does not have fear of Heaven.

aligned_segments.he: רָשָׁע שֶׁעָשָׂה חֲטָאִים רַבִּים, תַּקָּנָתוֹ - שֶׁיִּהְיֶה פְּעֻלּוֹתָיו לְחַיּוֹת אֶת הַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes the controversy surrounding a Tzaddik is a great proof that he is a Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he: קמב.
aligned_segments.en: There is an evildoer who is successful.

aligned_segments.he: כְּשֶׁרָשָׁע מַכְנִיעַ אֶת עַצְמוֹ תַּחַת הַצַּדִּיק, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁנִּגְזַר עַל הַצַּדִּיק אֵיזֶה צָרָה וְעַכְּשֶׁו לֹא יָבֹא עָלָיו עוֹד הַצָּרָה.
aligned_segments.en: But when he pursues (attacks) the Tzaddik, the Klipos (husks - impure forces) themselves take revenge on him. The difference between a Tzaddik  and one who has fear of Heaven, is that the one with fear does not have permission to reveal the mysteries of the Holy One Blessed He, whereas the Tzaddik  has permission.

aligned_segments.he:
קמג

 כְּשֶׁתִּירָא מֵהַצַּדִּיק, תִּזְכֶּה לָסוּר מֵרַע.
aligned_segments.en: One who slanders the Tzaddik, it is certain that he is arrogant. When the Holy One Blessed He wants the Tzaddik  to teach the people the Way of G-d, He hints this to him through his livelihood.

aligned_segments.he:
קמד 

כְּשֶׁהַצַּדִּיק שׁוֹרֶה בְּצַעַר וְהָרָשָׁע מְבַקֵּשׁ רַחֲמִים עָלָיו, עַל יְדֵי זֶה יִזְכֶּה לֶעָתִיד לַעֲמֹד עַל שַׁעֲרֵי צַדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: The Tzaddik – when he prays on behalf of someone, he can discern from which sin this suffering came upon the person. Someone who guards his covenant (circumcision) will certainly have love for the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
קמה

 מַה שֶׁלִּפְעָמִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֵינוֹ שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלַּת הַצַּדִּיק, כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּדְחֶה בְּזֶה אֶת הָרְשָׁעִים, שֶׁיִּשָּׁאֲרוּ בְּרִשְׁעוּתָן.
aligned_segments.en: When the Tzaddik serves the blessed G-d, without supervising the masses to teach them, through this he falls from his level. Through the income people provide for the livelihood of the Tzaddik, all their sins are forgiven.

aligned_segments.he:
קמו 

עַל יְדֵי מַחֲלֹקֶת עַל הַצַּדִּיק שׁוֹכְחִין אֶת הַתּוֹרָה.
aligned_segments.en: Just as (we find in the Torah) the Cohanim (priests) eat (of the sacrifices) and (by this) the owners (those that brought the sacrifices) are atoned.

aligned_segments.he:
קמז

 הַשֶּׁבַח שֶׁמְּשַׁבְּחִין אֶת הַצַּדִּיקִים, כְּאִלּוּ מְשַׁבְּחִין אֶת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
aligned_segments.en: By telling over stories of tzaddikim, one draws the light of Messiah into the world, and pushes out much darkness and hardship from the world.

aligned_segments.he:
קמח

 עִיר שֶׁהִיא צַיֵּת אֶת הַצַּדִּיק, אֵין מִלְחָמָה נִשְׁמַעַת בָּהּ וְאֵין מְהוּמָה וְאֵין שְׁמוּעָה רָעָה.
aligned_segments.en: Also, one merits to nice clothing. In the seven days of mourning over the Tzaddik, the Holy One Blessed He dispenses on the mourners from the hidden light of the Six Days of Creation.

aligned_segments.he:
קמט

 הַהִתְנַגְּדוּת עַל הַצַּדִּיקִים זֶה בָּא מֵהִתְנַגְּדוּת שֶׁבֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים בְּעַצְמָן.
aligned_segments.en: Do not be puzzled on the scheme, that man is a small creature and all the worlds are contingent on him. For such is the way with every place wherein the Divine Presence pervades; the little holds the large.

aligned_segments.he:
קנ

 בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא נוֹתֵן פַּרְנָסָה לַצַּדִּיק עַל יְדֵי הָמוֹן עִם, כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ אֵיזֶה הִתְחַבְּרוּת עִמָּהֶם, וּכְּשֶׁיִּזְכֹּר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת הַצַּדִּיק, יִזְכֹּר גַּם אוֹתָם.
aligned_segments.en: Every man has drawn in his visage his (portion in) Gan Eden (Heaven). For the most part, the G-d fearing – their livelihood comes through moving about. Sometimes the Tzaddik comes to moving from place to place, so that when he comes to the World to Come, he will remember all the places he had been, and through this good will come to all those places.

aligned_segments.he:
קנא

 בִּיאַת הַמָּשִׁיחַ תָּלוּי בְּקִרְבַת הַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: Someone who knows the names of the children of the tzaddikim of the generation, he knows all the events that are yet to come.

aligned_segments.he:
קנב

 עִקָּר שְׁלֵמוּת הַנֶּפֶשׁ תָּלוּי בְּקִרְבַת הַצַּדִּיק,
aligned_segments.en: Someone who justifies the people, all his interests are fulfilled without hindrance.

aligned_segments.he:
קנג

 מִי שֶׁמְּקָרֵב עַצְמוֹ לַצַּדִּיק וְקִרְבָתוֹ אֵינוֹ בִּתְמִימוּת, עַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְהַפֵּךְ אַחֵר כָּךְ לְרוֹדֵף.
aligned_segments.en: When a Tzaddik's strength is weakened, so that he cannot do the will of his Creator as before, he should know that the Holy One Blessed He no longer desires that he instruct the way of repentance to the wicked.

aligned_segments.he:
קנד 

הַשַּׁקְרָן בַּשָּׁעָה שֶׁבָּא לִרְאוֹת אֶת הַצַּדִּיק לִבּוֹ חוֹשֵׁב אֵיךְ יְדַבֵּר אַחֵר כָּךְ
aligned_segments.en: The main strength of the tzaddikim comes when the judgment is sweetened, that is, through the unification of the blessed name of G-d.

aligned_segments.he:
קנה

 הַדִּבּוּרִים שֶׁדּוֹבְרִים עַל הַצַּדִּיק לַסּוֹף שֶׁדִּבְרֵיהֶם נֶהֱפַךְ עֲלֵיהֶם, וְנוֹפְלִים לַמִּשְׁכָּב.
aligned_segments.en: When the tzaddikim become famous in the world, through this there are new melodies in the world. One who has self-sacrifice for the sake of the Jews (lit.

aligned_segments.he:
קנו

 מִי שֶׁמַּכְנִיעַ אֶת עַצְמוֹ בִּפְנֵי הַצַּדִּיק בְּזֶה מְעוֹרֵר אַהֲבָה אֵצֶל הַצַּדִּיק .
aligned_segments.en: Israel), the judgments he passes are not annulled, and what he decrees will be fulfilled. Through serving the Tzaddik comes freedom, and the curses are annulled.

aligned_segments.he:
קנז

 עַל יְדֵי סִפּוּרֵי מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת מַצְדִּיקִים עַל יְדֵי זֶה זוֹכִין לְהִתְקָרֵב לָהֶם.
aligned_segments.en: Those who are close to G-d fearing people, they also merit fear and cognizance. When a Tzaddik becomes wealthy, through this the wicked return in repentance.

aligned_segments.he:
קנח

 לְפִי רוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ, שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא נוֹתֵן לַצַּדִּיק כֵּן הָעֲשִׁירִים סוֹמְכִים אוֹתוֹ וּלְפִי סְמִיכָתָם אוֹתוֹ כֵּן יָכֹל לְהַחְזִיר הָרְשָׁעִים בַּתְּשׁוּבָה.
aligned_segments.en: When the Holy One Blessed He sees that a certain Tzaddik has the power to draw people to His service, He stands up on him enemies, in order that he will be able to draw the people (to G-d). Because a Tzaddik who does not have enemies, he cannot draw (people to G-d).

aligned_segments.he:
קנט

 הַיִּסּוּרִין שֶׁבְּאֵין עַל הַצַּדִּיקִים.
aligned_segments.en: This is comparable to the time of the arrival of the Messiah, they will reside in peace, and then converts will not be accepted.

aligned_segments.he: בִּשְׁבִיל כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יְהַרְהֲרוּ הָרְשָׁעִים לְעוֹלָם הַבָּא עַל הַטּוֹב. שֶׁיִּתֵּן הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לַצַּדִּיקִים.
aligned_segments.en: There are two Tzaddikim, that one, his words are like plowing, and the second, his words are like harvesting.

aligned_segments.he:
קס

 כְּשֶׁהַיְּרֵאִים הֵם בְּהִתְחַבְּרוּת עִם הַצַּדִּיק עַל יְדֵי זֶה גּוֹרְמִים זִוּוּג בֵּין קֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא ושכינתה פָּנִים בְּפָנִים . וְאֵין יְרִידָה אַחֲרָיו.
aligned_segments.en: Or one, his words are like the erection of the covenant (circumcision) for conjugation, and the second, his words are what draws the seed to impregnation and form the fetus in its mother's womb and develop it.

aligned_segments.he:
קסא

 עַל יְדֵי שֶׁבַח שֶׁמְּשַׁבְּחִים אֶת הַצַּדִּיקִים . מַפִּילִים אֶת הָרְשָׁעִים נְפִילָה גְּדוֹלָה
aligned_segments.en: Thus, when there is an argument between these two Tzaddikim, an outsider should not interfere in their words which they say against each other, so that he does not ruin the intended aim.

aligned_segments.he:
קסב

 הַצַּדִּיק נִסְתַּלֵּק בֶּעָווֹן כְּשֶׁוּף וְנִאוּף.
aligned_segments.en: When one goes to the tombs of the Tzaddikim, one needs merit to be able to draw his (the Tzaddik's) spirit and soul, to the tomb, (so it will be) as if he is alive.

aligned_segments.he:
קסג 

הַנּוֹאֲפִים לרב הֵם מִתְנַגְּדִים עַל הַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: For if there isn't merit, then his (the Tzaddik's) spirit and soul ascend to Heaven, to the midst of the other Tzaddikim.

aligned_segments.he:
קסד 

כְּשֶׁהַצַּדִּיק נִסְתַּלֵּק נִשְׁאָר הָעוֹלָם כִּטְמֵאִים וְצִדְקַת הָעוֹלָם נִמְאָס בְּעֵינֵי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
aligned_segments.en: Through mentioning the names of the Tzaddikim, one can bring changes in the Creation, that is to say, to change nature (do the supernatural).

aligned_segments.he:
קסה

 עַל יְדֵי הַגְדָּלַת הָעוֹלָם עַל הַצַּדִּיק נִתְעוֹרֵר חַס וְשָׁלוֹם חֲרוֹן אַף גַּם שְׂרֵפָה נִתְעוֹרֵר.
aligned_segments.en: 154. A liar – when he comes to see the Tzaddik - his heart contemplates how he will speak afterwards.

aligned_segments.he:
קסו

 טִלְטוּל הַצַּדִּיקִים .לִפְעָמִים הוּא בִּשְׁבִיל לְגַלּוֹת אֵיזֶה צַדִּיק נִסְתָּר.
aligned_segments.en: 155. The words that people speak against the Tzaddik, in the end their words are turned around against them, and they fall bedridden.

aligned_segments.he:
קסז

 לִפְעָמִים יִסּוּרִין בָּאָיֹם עַל הַצַּדִּיק, כְּדֵי לְמַעֵט בְּצָרוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל.
aligned_segments.en: 156. One who submits himself before the Tzaddik, with this he arouses the love of the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
קסח

 מִלּוּי כְּרֵסָם שֶׁל הָמוֹן עַם גּוֹרֵם לַאֲבֵדַת הַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: 157. Through the stories of the tzaddikim, through this one merits to draw close to them.

aligned_segments.he:
קסט 

יִסּוּרִים שֶׁבָּאִים עַל הַצַּדִּיק הוּא כַּפָּרָה עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל.
aligned_segments.en: 158. According to the Divine Inspiration the Holy One Blessed He grants to a Tzaddik, so the wealthy people support him. According to the support they give him, so he can bring the evildoers back in repentance.

aligned_segments.he:
קע

 מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ רוֹצֶה לְקַבֵּל עַל עַצְמוֹ עֹל שֶׁל הַצַּדִּיק, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא כּוֹעֵס עָלָיו ומבעתהו.
aligned_segments.en: An indication for this matter is: "These are the offspring (chronicles) of the Heaven and the Earth (Bereshit 1:1)", and "These are the names of the children of Israel (Shemot 1:1)" – syllogism [- gezaira shuvva - the usage of the words "These are" in both passages is the basis to apply what is found by one of them to the other].

aligned_segments.he:
קעא 

מִי שֶׁמֵּבִיא דּוֹרוֹן לַצַּדִּיק ,הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עוֹשֶׂה לוֹ נַחַת רוּחַ.
aligned_segments.en: One who knows from the Land of Israel, who has truly tasted the taste of the Land of Israel, he can recognize in another if he had been by a Tzaddik on Rosh HaShana (the Jewish New Years) or not.

aligned_segments.he:
קעב

 עַל יְדֵי דּוֹרוֹן שֶׁמְּבִיאִין לַצַּדִּיקִים מַכְנִיעִין אֶת הַשּׂוֹנְאִים וּמְבַטְּלִין אֶת הָרוּחַ רָעָה שֶׁשּׁוֹרָה עַל הָאָדָם.
aligned_segments.en: Because one who merits to be by a true Tzaddik on Rosh HaShana, then in every place where this person looks, the air of that place becomes the aspect of the air of the Land of Israel.

aligned_segments.he:
קעג 

עַל יְדֵי הִשְׁתַּטְּחוּת עַל קִבְרֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עוֹשֶׂה לוֹ טוֹבוֹת, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינוֹ רָאוּי לְכָךְ.
aligned_segments.en: Therefore, one who knows from the taste of the Land of Israel, each according to his level, it is imperative for him to sense the Land of Israel, when he meets and gets together with this man who had been by the true Tzaddik  on Rosh HaShana.

aligned_segments.he:
קעד 

מִי שֶׁמִּסְפָּר מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת מַצְדִּיקִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עוֹשֶׂה לוֹ חֶסֶד.
aligned_segments.en: 163. The promiscuous are for the most part opposers of the tzaddikim.

aligned_segments.he:
קעה

 מַה שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק מַנְהִיג אֶת הָעוֹלָם,הוּא מֵחֲמַת יִרְאָה שֶׁבְּתוֹכוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: 164. When the Tzaddik passes away, the world (the people) remain as though impure, and the righteousness of the world is disgusting in the eyes of the Holy One Blessed He.

aligned_segments.he:
קעו 

כְּשֶׁאָדָם נִתְבָּרֵךְ מִן הַצַּדִּיק צָרִיךְ לַעֲמֹד עַל רַגְלָיו.
aligned_segments.en: For at his hand the air becomes of the aspect of the Land of Israel, as explained above.

aligned_segments.he:
קעז

 הַמֶּלֶךְ גּוֹבֶה מִן הָעָם.
aligned_segments.en: For at his hand the air becomes of the aspect of the Land of Israel, as explained above.

aligned_segments.he:
קעח 

עַל יְדֵי כָּבוֹד, שֶׁמְּכַבְּדִין אֶת בְּנֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים, נִתְעוֹרֵר רָצוֹן אֵצֶל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרֵךְ שֶׁיָּבוֹא הַמָּשִׁיחַ.
aligned_segments.en: 167. Sometimes suffering comes upon the Tzaddik, in order to decrease the hardships of Israel.

aligned_segments.he:
קעט

 עַל יְדֵי הַהֲלִיכָה שֶׁהוֹלְכִים לַצַּדִּיק,מַכְנִיעִים אֶת הַשּׂוֹנְאִים.
aligned_segments.en: 168. The gluttonous eating of the masses causes the loss of the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
קפ 

מִי שֶׁעוֹבֵר עַל הַצִּוּוּי שֶׁל הַצַּדִּיק, הוּא נוֹפֵל מֵחֲשִׁיבוּתוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: 169. The sufferings that come upon the tzaddikim are an atonement for all of the Jewish People.

aligned_segments.he:
קפא

 מִי שמהנהו מִנְּכָסָיו כָּאֵלּוּ מְהַנֶּה כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִצּוֹל מִמִּיתָה.
aligned_segments.en: 170. One who does not want to accept upon himself the yoke of the Tzaddik, the Holy One Blessed He is angry at him and kicks him.

aligned_segments.he:
קפב 

מִי שֶׁמְּסָרֵב עַל דִּבְרֵי צַדִּיק כָּאֵלּוּ שָׁאַל בַּקּוֹסְמִים.
aligned_segments.en: For at his hand the air becomes of the aspect of the Land of Israel, as explained above.

aligned_segments.he:
קפג

 עַל יְדֵי הַחָכְמָה ה' עִמּוֹ גַּם אֵימָתוֹ מטלת עַל הַבְּרִיּוֹת.
aligned_segments.en: For at his hand the air becomes of the aspect of the Land of Israel, as explained above.

aligned_segments.he:
קפד 

מִי שֶׁסּוֹמֵךְ אֶת הַצַּדִּיק בְּכָל מִינֵי סְמִיכוֹת, הוּא סָמוּךְ וְקָרוֹב לוֹ לְעוֹלָם הַבָּא.
aligned_segments.en: 173. Through prostrating oneself on the tombs of tzaddikim, the Holy One Blessed He does favors for him, even if he is not worthy of such.

aligned_segments.he:
קפה 

מִי שֶׁמִּתְגָּרֶה בַּצַּדִּיק, לַסּוֹף הוּא נִתְפַּס בִּמְצוּדָה רָעָה.
aligned_segments.en: 174. Someone who recounts stories of the tzaddikim, the Holy One Blessed He does him kindness.

aligned_segments.he:
קפו 

מִי שֶׁמְּסַפֵּר מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת מַצְדִּיקִים, מַזְכִּירִין לוֹ צִדְקוֹתָיו.
aligned_segments.en: 175. That which the Tzaddik rules over the world (-people) is due to the fear of G-d within him.

aligned_segments.he:
קפז 

הַצַּדִּיק יָכֹל לִתֵּן דָּבָר, שֶׁלֹּא בָּא לְעוֹלָם.
aligned_segments.en: For at his hand the air becomes of the aspect of the Land of Israel, as explained above.

aligned_segments.he:
קפח 

הַצַדִּיק,כָּל מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִדְרֹךְ כַּף רַגְלָיו, הוּא קוֹנֶה.
aligned_segments.en: For at his hand the air becomes of the aspect of the Land of Israel, as explained above.

aligned_segments.he:
קפט 

מִי שֶנוֹתֵן עֵצָה לַצַּדִּיקִים בְּעֵת הִתְנַגְּדוּת מַעֲשֶׂה יָדָיו קַיָּמִים, וְאֵין מְבַטֵּל אוֹתָם.
aligned_segments.en: 178. Through the honor people extend to the children of the tzaddikim, the desire is aroused in the blessed G-d for the arrival of the Messiah.

aligned_segments.he:
קצ 

בַּשָּׁעָה שֶׁמִּסְתַּכֵּל עַל הַצַּדִּיק, יִסְתַּכֵּל בָּאֵימָה, כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יַעַנְשׁוּ אוֹתוֹ מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם.
aligned_segments.en: 179. Through the (act of) going – that people go to the Tzaddik, they subdue the wicked.

aligned_segments.he:
קצא 

עַל יְדֵי יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם נִשְׁתּוֹקֵק הָאָדָם לְקָרֵב אֶת עַצְמוֹ לַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: 180. One who transgresses the command of the Tzaddik, he falls from his importance.

aligned_segments.he:
קצב

 עַל יְדֵי יְשִׁיבָה אֵצֶל שֻׁלְחָן הַצַּדִּיק נִתְבַּטֵּל הַמִּלְחָמָה.
aligned_segments.en: 181. One who gives the Tzaddik enjoyment (benefit) from his property, is as if he benefited all of Israel, and he is saved from death.

aligned_segments.he:
קצג

 מִי שֶׁהוּא זַיְפָן, לְסוֹף שֶׁיִּתְחַבֵּר עִם הַמִּתְנַגְּדִים שֶׁחוֹלְקִים עַל הַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: 182. One who disobeys (by refusal to perform) the words of the Tzaddik, is as if he engaged in the asking of diviners.

aligned_segments.he:
קצד

 לִפְעָמִים הַצָּרַעַת פּוֹרֵחַ לַצַּדִּיק, כִּי מִקָּרוֹב קְרַב אֵיזֶה אָדָם בִּתְשׁוּבָה.
aligned_segments.en: 183. Through wisdom, G-d is with one, and also the fear of him is cast upon the people.

aligned_segments.he:
קצה

 מִי שֶׁאוֹמֵר עַל הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁהוּא רָשָׁע וְעַל הָרָשָׁע שֶׁהוּא צַדִּיק עַל ¬¬-יְדֵי- זֶה יִפֹּל לַחֻלְשָׁה גַּם עַל יְדֵי זֶה חַמָּה וּלְבֵנָה נִלְקִין.
aligned_segments.en: 184. One who supports the Tzaddik with all types of support, he is close and near to him in the World to Come.

aligned_segments.he:
קצו

 הִתְקַשְּׁרוּת לַצַּדִּיק הוּא רְפוּאָה גְּדוֹלָה.
aligned_segments.en: For at his hand the air becomes of the aspect of the Land of Israel, as explained above.

aligned_segments.he:
קצז

 קָשֶׁה לָאָדָם לְהַשִּׂיג אֵיזֶה תְּשׁוּעָה, כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ צַדִּיק בָּעִיר וְאֵינוֹ מְבַקֵּשׁ מִמֶּנּוּ שֶׁיִּתְפַּלֵּל עָלָיו.
aligned_segments.en: 186. One who recounts the stories of tzaddikim, his righteousness is recalled.

aligned_segments.he:
קצח 

לִפְעָמִים יֵשׁ אֶחָד, שֶׁמְּקֹרָב בְּהִתְקָרְבוּת גָּדוֹל לַצַּדִּיק וְאֵינוֹ מַרְגִּישׁ בְּעַצְמוֹ שׁוּם יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם, יָדַע, כִּי אִם לֹא הָיָה מְקֹרָב לֹא הָיָה רָאוּי לִחְיוֹת כְּלָל.
aligned_segments.en: 187. The Tzaddik can give something that has not yet come into the world.

aligned_segments.he:
קצט 

לִפְעָמִים הַצַּדִּיק מִתְבַּיֵּשׁ לְבַקֵּשׁ מֵהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עַל צַעֲרוֹ מַה עוֹשֶׂה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מֵבִיא צַעַר כָּזֶה עַל רָשָׁע כְּדֵי כְּשֶׁהָרָשָׁע בָּא וּמְבַקֵּשׁ מִמֶּנּוּ שֶׁיִּתְפַּלֵּל עָלָיו עַל יְדֵי זֶה נִצּוֹל גַּם הַצַּדִּיק מִצַּעֲרוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: 188. The Tzaddik – everywhere his feet tread, he acquires.

aligned_segments.he:
ר 

מִי שֶׁחוֹלֵק עַל הַצַּדִּיק בְּפָנָיו בַּיָּדוּעַ שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם.
aligned_segments.en: 189. Someone who gives advice to tzaddikim at a time when they are facing opposition, the work of his hands endures, and will not be annulled.

aligned_segments.he:
רא

 לִפְעָמִים הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת עַל הַצַּדִּיק הִיא הוֹכָחָה גְּדוֹלָה שֶׁהוּא צַדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: 190. At the time when one looks upon the Tzaddik, he should look with dread, so that he will not be punished by Heaven.

aligned_segments.he:
רב

 יֵשׁ רָשָׁע שֶׁמַּצְלִיחַ וּכְּשֶׁרוֹדֵף אֶת הַצַּדִּיק אֲזַי הַקְּלִפּוֹת בְּעַצְמָם נוֹקְמִים מִמֶּנּוּ
aligned_segments.en: 191. Through fear of Heaven, a persons gains a longing to draw himself close to the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
רג 

הַחִלּוּק שֶׁבֵּין צַדִּיק לִירֵא שָׁמַיִם שֶׁהַיָּרֵא אֵין לוֹ רְשׁוּת לְגַלּוֹת מִסְתּוֹרָיו שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֲבָל הַצַּדִּיק יֵשׁ לוֹ רְשׁוּת.
aligned_segments.en: 192. Through sitting at the table of the Tzaddik, war is annulled.

aligned_segments.he:
רד

 מִי שֶׁדּוֹבֵר עַל הַצַּדִּיק בַּיָּדוּעַ שֶׁהוּא גַּדְלָן
aligned_segments.en: 193. One who is a forger, in the end he will join the opposers who stand against the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
רה

 כְּשֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא רוֹצֶה שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק יִלְמַד דֶּרֶךְ אֶת הָעָם מְרַמֵּז לוֹ בְּפַרְנָסָתוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: 194. Sometimes the plague of leprosy breaks out upon the Tzaddik, because he had recently brought someone back in repentance.

aligned_segments.he:
רו 

הַצַּדִּיק כְּשֶׁמִּתְפַּלֵּל עַל הָאָדָם, הוּא מֵבִין עַל אֵיזֶה עֲבֵרָה בָּא עָלָיו הַפֻּרְעָנוּת הַזֹּאת.
aligned_segments.en: 195. Someone who says of a Tzaddik that he is wicked, and of a wicked one that he is a Tzaddik, through this he falls into a state of weakness, also the sun and moon are eclipsed.

aligned_segments.he:
רז

מִי שֶׁשּׁומֵר אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ בְּוַדַּאי מְחַבֵּב אֶת הַצַּדִּיק.
aligned_segments.en: 196. Connection to the Tzaddik is a great healing.

aligned_segments.he:
רח 

כְּשֶׁהַצַּדִּיק עוֹבֵד אֶת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרֵךְ וְאֵינוֹ מַשְׁגִּיחַ עַל הָמוֹן עִם לְלַמֵּד עַל יְדֵי זֶה נוֹפֵל מִמַּדְרֵגָתוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: 197. It is hard for a man to receive a salvation, when there is a Tzaddik in the city, and he (the man) does not ask the Tzaddik to pray for him.

aligned_segments.he:
רט 

עִיֵּל יְדֵי הַפַּרְנָסָה שֶׁמְּפַרְנְסִין אֶת הַצַּדִּיק נִמְחַל לָהֶם כָּל עֲווֹנוֹתֵיהֶם כְּמוֹ הַכֹּהֲנִים אוֹכְלִים וּבְעָלִים מִתְכַּפְּרִים.
aligned_segments.en: 198. Sometimes a person comes very close to the Tzaddik, and yet does not feel within himself any fear of Heaven. He should know that if he had not come close, he would not be worthy of living at all.

aligned_segments.he: חֵלֶק שֵׁנִי

א 

עַל יְדֵי סִפּוּרי מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים מַמְשִׁיכִין אוֹר שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ בָּעוֹלָם וְדוֹחֶה הַרְבֵּה חֹשֶׁךְ וְצָרוֹת מִן הָעוֹלָם.
aligned_segments.en: 199. Sometimes a Tzaddik is ashamed to pray to the Holy One Blessed He about his personal suffering. What does the Holy One Blessed He do? He brings similar suffering upon an evildoer, so that when the evildoer comes and asks from him (the tzaddik) to pray for him, and through this, the Tzaddik is also saved from his suffering.

aligned_segments.he:
ב 

גַּם זוֹכֶה לִבְגָדִים נָאִים.
aligned_segments.en: 200. One who disputes the Tzaddik in front of him, it is certain that he does not have fear of Heaven.

aligned_segments.he:
ג 

בְּשִׁבְעַת יְמֵי אֲבֵלוּת שֶׁל הַצַּדִּיק, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מַשְׁפִּיעַ עַל הַמִּתְאַבְּלִים עָלָיו מֵאוֹר הַגָּנוּז מִשֵּׁשֶׁת יְמֵי בְּרֵאשִׁית.
aligned_segments.en: 201. Sometimes the controversy surrounding a Tzaddik is a great proof that he is a Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
ד

 אַל תִּתְמַהּ עַל הַחֵפֶץ, שֶׁהָאָדָם הוּא בְּרִיָּה קְטַנָּה וּבוֹ תָּלוּי כָּל הָעוֹלָמוֹת, כִּי כֵן בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁהַשְּׁכִינָה שְׁרוּיָה, מוּעָט מַחֲזִיק אֶת הַמְּרֻבֶּה.
aligned_segments.en: 202. There is an evildoer who is successful. But when he pursues (attacks) the Tzaddik, the Klipos (husks - impure forces) themselves take revenge on him.

aligned_segments.he:
ה 

כָּל אָדָם מְצֻיָּר בְּזִּיו פָּנָיו גַּן עֵדֶן שֶׁלּוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: 203. The difference between a Tzaddik and one who has fear of Heaven, is that the one with fear does not have permission to reveal the mysteries of the Holy One Blessed He, whereas the Tzaddik has permission.

aligned_segments.he:
ו

 עַל פִּי רֹב הַיְּרֵאִים פַּרְנָסָתָם בָּא עַל יְדֵי טִלְטוּלִים.
aligned_segments.en: 204. One who slanders the Tzaddik, it is certain that he is arrogant.

aligned_segments.he:
ז 

לִפְעָמִים הַצַּדִּיק בָּא לַטִּלְטוּלִים, כְּדֵי שֶׁיָּבֹא לְעוֹלָם הַבָּא יִזְכֹּר הַמְּקוֹמוֹת שֶׁהָיוּ בָּהֶם, וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יָבוֹאוּ טוֹבוֹת לְאֵלּוּ הַמְּקוֹמוֹת.
aligned_segments.en: 205. When the Holy One Blessed He wants the Tzaddik to teach the people the Way of G-d, He hints this to him through his livelihood.

aligned_segments.he:
ח 

מִי שֶׁיּוֹדֵעַ שֵׁמוֹת שֶׁל בְּנֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים שֶׁבַּדּוֹר, הוּא יוֹדֵעַ כָּל הַמְּאֹרָעוֹת שֶׁיִּהְיוּ.
aligned_segments.en: 206. The Tzaddik – when he prays on behalf of someone, he can discern from which sin this suffering came upon the person.

aligned_segments.he:
ט

 מִי שֶׁמַּצְדִּיק אֶת הַבְּרִיּוֹת, כָּל חֲפָצָיו נַעֲשִׂים בְּלִי שׁוּם מוֹנֵעַ .
aligned_segments.en: 207. Someone who guards his covenant (circumcision) will certainly have love for the Tzaddik.

aligned_segments.he:
י 

כְּשֶׁהַצַּדִּיק נֶחֱלָשׁ כֹּחוֹ, שֶׁאֵין יָכֹל לַעֲשׂוֹת רָצוֹן קוֹנוֹ כְּמִקֹּדֶם, יֵדַע, שֶׁאֵין הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא רוֹצֶה עוֹד, שֶׁיּוֹרֶה דֶּרֶךְ תְּשׁוּבָה לָרְשָׁעִים.
aligned_segments.en: 208. When the Tzaddik serves the blessed G-d, without supervising the masses to teach them, through this he falls from his level.

aligned_segments.he:
יא 

עִקֵּר כֹּחַ הַצַּדִּיקִים הוּא כְּשֶׁהַדִּין נִמְתָּק, הַיְנוּ:
עַל יְדֵי אַחְדוּת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרֵךְ.
aligned_segments.en: Through the income people provide for the livelihood of the Tzaddik, all their sins are forgiven. Just as (we find in the Torah) the Cohanim (priests) eat (of the sacrifices) and (by this) the owners (those that brought the sacrifices) are atoned.

aligned_segments.he:
יב 

כְּשֶׁהַצַּדִּיקִים נִתְפַּרְסְמִים בָּעוֹלָם עַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְחַדְּשִׁים נִגּוּנִים בָּעוֹלָם.
aligned_segments.en: 1. By telling over stories of tzaddikim, one draws the light of Messiah into the world, and pushes out much darkness and hardship from the world.

aligned_segments.he:
יג 

מִי שֶׁמּוֹסֵר נַפְשׁוֹ בִּשְׁבִיל יִשְׂרָאֵל,דִּינָיו אֵינָם בְּטֵלִים,וְכַאֲשֶׁר יִגְזֹר כֵּן יָקוּם.
aligned_segments.en: 2. Also, one merits to nice clothing.

aligned_segments.he:
יד 

עַל יְדֵי שִׁמּוּשׁ הַצַּדִּיק בָּא חֵרוּת וְנִתְבַּטֵּל הַקְּלָלוֹת .
aligned_segments.en: 3. In the seven days of mourning over the Tzaddik, the Holy One Blessed He dispenses on the mourners from the hidden light of the Six Days of Creation.

aligned_segments.he:
טו 

אֵלּוּ הַמְּקֹרָבִים לִירֵאֵי הַשֵּׁם גַּם הֵם זוֹכִים לְיִרְאָה וְלָדַעַת.
aligned_segments.en: 4. Do not be puzzled on the scheme, that man is a small creature and all the worlds are contingent on him. For such is the way with every place wherein the Divine Presence pervades; the little holds the large.

aligned_segments.he:
טז 

כְּשֶׁהַצַּדִּיק נִתְעַשֵּׁר עַל יְדֵי זֶה הָרְשָׁעִים חוֹזְרִים בַּתְּשׁוּבָה.
aligned_segments.en: 5. Every man has drawn in his visage his (portion in) Gan Eden (Heaven).

aligned_segments.he:
יז 

כְּשֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא רוֹאֶה אֵיזֶה צַדִּיק שֶׁיֵּשׁ כֹּחַ בְּיָדוֹ לְקָרֵב בְּנֵי אָדָם לַעֲבוֹדָתוֹ,, אֲזַי מַעֲמִיד עָלָיו שׂוֹנְאִים כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכַל לְקָרֵב בְּנֵי אָדָם, כִּי הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁאֵין לוֹ שׂוֹנְאִים אֵין יָכֹל לְקָרֵב,, כְּמוֹ בְּעֵת בִּיאַת הַמָּשִׁיחַ יֵשְׁבוּ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְאֵין מְקַבְּלִים גֵּרִים.
aligned_segments.en: 6. For the most part, the G-d fearing – their livelihood comes through moving about.

aligned_segments.he:
יח 

יֵשׁ שֵׁנִי צַדִּיקִים שֶׁאֶחָד דִּבּוּרָיו הֵם כַּחֲרִישָׁה, וְהַשֵּׁנִי דְּבָרָיו כִּקְצִירָה, אוֹ אֶחָד, דְּבָרָיו כַּהֲקָמַת הַבְּרִית לַזִּוּוּג, וְהַשֵּׁנִי דְּבָרָיו הֵם הַמַּמְשִׁיכִין אֶת הַזֶּרַע וּמְהַוִּים אֶת הַוָּלָד בְּבֶטֶן אִמּוֹ וּמְגַדְּלִין אוֹתוֹ.
בְּכֵן כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ מַחֲלֹקֶת בֵּין שֵׁנִי צַדִּיקִים הָאֵלּוּ אַל יִתְעָרֵב זָר בְּתוֹךְ דִּבּוּרָיו שֶׁמְּדַבְּרִים זֶה עַל זֶה כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יְקַלְקֵל הַמְּכֻוָּן.
aligned_segments.en: Sometimes the Tzaddik comes to moving from place to place, so that when he comes to the World to Come, he will remember all the places he had been, and through this good will come to all those places.

aligned_segments.he:
יט 

כְּשֶׁהוֹלְכִים עַל קִבְרֵי צַדִּיקִים צָרִיךְ לַזֶּה זְכוּת שֶׁיּוּכַל לֶאֱסֹף רוּחוֹ וְנִשְׁמָתוֹ לַקֶּבֶר, שֶׁיִּהְיֶה כְּאִלּוּ הוּא חַי, כִּי אִם אֵין זְכוּת, אֲזַי רוּחוֹ וְנִשְׁמָתוֹ עוֹלִים לְמַעְלָה לְתוֹךְ שְׁאָר הַצַּדִּיקִים.
aligned_segments.en: 8. Someone who knows the names of the children of the tzaddikim of the generation, he knows all the events that are yet to come.

aligned_segments.he:
כ

 עַל יְדֵי הַזְכָּרַת שֵׁמוֹת הַצַּדִּיקִים יְכוֹלִים לְהָבִיא שִׁנּוּי בַּמַּעֲשֶׂה בְּרֵאשִׁית, כְּלוֹמַר לְשַׁנּוֹת הַטֶּבַע. וְסִימָן לַדָּבָר: אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ וכו', וְאֵלֶּה שֵׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וכו', גְּזֵרָה שָׁוָה.
aligned_segments.en: 9. Someone who justifies the people, all his interests are fulfilled without hindrance.

aligned_segments.he:
כא 

מִי שֶׁיּוֹדֵעַ מֵאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל,, שֶׁטָּעַם בֶּאֱמֶת טָעַם אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל,, הוּא יָכֹל לְהַכִּיר בְּאַחֵר אִם הָיָה אֵצֶל צַדִּיק אֲמִתִּי עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה אִם לָאו,
כִּי מִי שֶׁזּוֹכֶה לִהְיוֹת אֵצֶל צַדִּיק אֲמִתִּי עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה,, אֲזַי בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁהָאִישׁ הַזֶּה מִסְתַּכֵּל נַעֲשָׂה אוֹתוֹ הָאֲוִיר בְּחִינַת אֲוִירָא דְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל,
aligned_segments.en:
When a Tzaddik's strength is weakened, so that he cannot do the will of his Creator as before, he should know that the Holy One Blessed He no longer desires that he instruct the way of repentance to the wicked.

11.

aligned_segments.he: וְעַל כֵּן מִי שֶׁיּוֹדֵעַ מִטַּעַם אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל אֶחָד לְפִי עֶרְכּוֹ,, הוּא מְחֻיָּב לְהַרְגִּישׁ אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּשֶׁפּוֹגֵעַ וּמִתְוַעֵד יַחַד עִם זֶה הָאִישׁ שֶׁהָיָה אֵצֶל הַצַּדִּיק אֲמִתִּי עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה, כִּי עַל יָדוֹ נַעֲשָׂה הָאֲוִיר בִּבְחִינַת אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּנָּ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: The main strength of the tzaddikim comes when the judgment is sweetened, that is, through the unification of the blessed name of G-d.
